annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) No 407/2011 amending Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 as regards the inclusion of certain UNECE Regulations on the type-approval of motor vehicles
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) No 407/2011 amending Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 as regards the inclusion of certain UNECE Regulations on the type-approval of motor vehicles
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 108/13
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission regulation replacing Annex IV of Regulation 661/2009 to make a list of UNECE vehicle regulations compulsory for EC type-approval of motor vehicles, replacing duplicate EU directives. It covers conventional vehicle components such as lighting, braking, and seat belts. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex IV of Regulation 661/2009 is replaced with a list of compulsory UNECE Regulations
UNECE Regulations apply to EC type-approval of new vehicle types from 1 November 2012
They apply to registration, sale and entry into service from 1 November 2014
UNECE Regulation 100 on electric safety applies from 2011-2012
Aims to avoid duplicated requirements and improve market access
